identity.name: Academia Endless Drive
identity.one_liner: The DeWitt Academia Endless Drive — a 42mm steel case with an off-centre "perpetual" sub-second hand that traces a 1/1000th-of-an-hour reading, the brand's most-photographed Asian-flavored piece.

provenance_events.description: DeWitt releases the Academia Endless Drive — a 42mm steel case with the in-house DW704 automatic movement.

narrative.story: The DeWitt Academia Endless Drive is the brand's most-photographed piece — a 42mm steel case with the in-house DW704 automatic movement, off-centre dial layout, and the "Endless Drive" sub-second hand.
narrative.collector_notes: The Endless Drive is one of the most-photographed Asian haute pieces of the 2010s. The sub-second hand rotates continuously, tracing the "endless drive" of time.
